facts.text: I keep getting xanthomas, fatty lumps in my skin; they keep coming back.
They first appeared before I was 10.
They were surgically removed several times when I was a teenager.
Right now I have them over my elbows and on my eyelids.

aliases: coronary artery disease in the family
facts.text: My mother died suddenly at 60; it was possibly from early coronary artery disease.
My sister had xanthomas as a child.
My sister has high cholesterol that stays high, with an LDL of about 140 mg/dL, even on a statin.
